ABOUT · /about

Mobile · About

Our Story

About
Volpino

Local. Earthy. Shared.

The Restaurant

A neighbourhood pizzeria
& wine bar

Mount Martha · Mornington Peninsula

Volpino Pizzeria and Wine Bar is located directly opposite Mount Martha beach, just a short walk from the foreshore. We opened with a simple idea — cook over fire, source locally, and share everything.

Our menu draws from the Italian tradition of using quality ingredients simply. Wood-fired pizza and house-made pasta sit alongside small plates designed for the table to share. The wine list leans natural, with a focus on small producers from Victoria and Italy.

Our name — Volpino, the little fox — speaks to curiosity, craft, and a genuine love of good things.

How we cook

Wood fire, local produce,
honest food

Wood-fired oven

Everything we can, we cook over wood. The oven runs all day, giving our pizza bases their char and our vegetables their depth.

Local producers

We work with farmers and producers on the Mornington Peninsula. Seasonal availability shapes what appears on the menu.

House-made pasta

All pasta is made in-house daily. We make shapes that suit the sauce, not the other way around.

Natural wine

Our wine list celebrates small producers who farm organically and make wine with minimal intervention.
